column1: **lsf_horMnSubTerms:** Large-scale subsidence terms Switch 0=off 1=on *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_w_surf:** Large-scale forcing to w at the surface *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_w_lev1:** Large-scale forcing to w at the first specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_w_lev2:** Large-scale forcing to w at the second specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_w_zlev1:** Large-scale forcing to w height 1 *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_w_zlev2:** Large-scale forcing to w height 2 *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_th_surf:** Large-scale forcing to theta at the surface *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_th_lev1:** Large-scale forcing to theta at the first specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_th_lev2:** Large-scale forcing to theta at the second specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_th_zlev1:** Large-scale forcing to theta height 1 *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_th_zlev2:** Large-scale forcing to theta height 2 *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_qv_surf:** Large-scale forcing to qv at the first specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_qv_lev1:** Large-scale forcing to qv at the first specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_qv_lev2:** Large-scale forcing to qv at the second specified level *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_qv_zlev1:** Large-scale forcing to qv height 1 *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
**lsf_qv_zlev2:** Large-scale forcing to qv height 2 *C-M if lsfSelector > 0*
